# Designer's personal rules

Empty. The Chronicler fills this in after you approve - once the same edit
of yours repeats across projects.

Format: one rule, one bullet line. A rule you are happy to hand to the
PUBLIC seed is marked at the end of THAT SAME line:

    - Show validation errors at the field (promote candidate)

`orchestra -Share` takes only the marked lines and asks about each one
separately. A marker on a heading does nothing and does not extend to
neighbouring lines - that is deliberate.
